identified_issues: Violation of Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing Standard Operating Procedure 12.1 (Requirement 3: Predecessor Review State Binding).
Missing cryptographic binding between robotic dispatch payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842 and the pharmacist verification record EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991.
Technician proposal violates fail-closed defensive design principles by attempting to advance compounding execution without required predecessor state hash verification.
evidence: Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing Standard Operating Procedure 12.1 explicitly requires each robotic compounding execution to be verifiably bound to the exact clinical order verification state via the review event hash.
Console log for PHARM_STATION_03 recorded review sign-off record EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991 with Record SHA-256 Digest d4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0.
Compounding dispatch payload MSG_DISPATCH_8842 contains 'predecessor_review_event_hash': null, completely omitting the mandatory predecessor review event hash.
recommended_action: Halt compounding execution immediately and reject the technician's proposal to override the queue. Enforce strict ingress schema validation on the compounding robot controller to fail-closed when predecessor_review_event_hash is null, missing, or mismatched. Re-dispatch the message with the valid SHA-256 digest (d4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0) and verify the hash match against the clinical registry before initiating mechanical compounding.
